extracted.name: Crab Dip
extracted.description: This easy Crab Dip recipe is meant to impress, made with fresh lump crab meat in a creamy dip that can be served hot or cold.
ingredient_lines: 8 ounce package cream cheese (, room temperature)
1 cup freshly shredded cheddar cheese (, divided)
½ teaspoon hot sauce (, or more, to taste)
1 pound fresh jumbo lump crab meat
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F. Add cream cheese to a mixing bowl and beat until smooth. Stir in mayo, sour cream, garlic, green onion, Old Bay seasoning, salt, Worcestershire, and lemon juice.
Add ¾ cup cheddar cheese and hot sauce and mix until smooth. Stir in crab meat.
Spread into a 9″ pie dish or similar size baking pan and sprinkle remaining cheddar cheese on top. Bake for about 20 minutes or until the top is golden and bubbly.
Serve warm, with slices of sourdough bread, crackers, tortilla chips or chopped cold veggies.
Leftover crab dip will keep, stored covered in the fridge, for up to 3 days. Rewarm in the microwave.
